sources.title: Jamba foundation models and API versioning
sources.evidence: Current API alias jamba-large points to jamba-large-1.7-2025-07. The Large row reports 398B parameters, 94B active, version 1.7 and 256K tokens. The page identifies AI21 Labs, the Jamba family, and text input/output. Jamba Large 1.5 and 1.6 are separately listed as deprecated snapshots.

sources.title: AI21-Jamba-Large-1.7 model card
sources.evidence: The exact 1.7 card describes a hybrid SSM-Transformer model with 94B active/398B total parameters, a 256K context and grounding/instruction-following improvements. It assigns the Jamba Open Model License and provides deployment instructions including MoE quantization. Weights are gated by acceptance of conditions.

sources.title: AI21 changelog: Introducing Jamba 1.7
sources.evidence: The July 3, 2025 entry explicitly states the Jamba 1.7 release date and links the Jamba Large 1.7 model card.

sources.title: Jamba Open Model License Agreement
sources.evidence: The license linked by the exact 1.7 model card permits specified uses subject to conditions, including a commercial-use restriction above USD 50 million annual revenue. It is a custom license, not Apache-2.0 or an unrestricted open-source license.

sources.title: Function Calling
sources.evidence: AI21 explicitly states that function calling is available for all Jamba models through the Chat Completions API.

sources.title: Jamba Chat request API reference
sources.evidence: Despite the historical URL, the current page documents the jamba-large alias and instruction-following chat API, including function tools. Its documented request schema has no reasoning/thinking option; absence does not prove the catalog's broader reasoning boolean false.

sources.title: Public metadata for AI21-Jamba-Large-1.7
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated metadata at revision f95d1c3c9ac9028a9306e717047b5515e73c1dd1 reports JambaForCausalLM, model_type jamba, 16 experts, 2 experts per token, and 398555145696 BF16 safetensors parameters. The tokenizer template contains function-call handling. This corroborates the MoE component and explains the UI's rounded 399B count.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration file
sources.evidence: The unauthenticated configuration-file request returned HTTP 401. No exact max_position_embeddings value was verified from this gated file. Public model card and repository metadata remained accessible.

name.note: Official display name for the rolling alias; its reviewed target is version 1.7.

developer.note: The official documentation identifies the developing organization.

family.note: Normalized name of the official Jamba family.

release_date.note: Explicit public release date for the 1.7 snapshot currently served by the alias, not the original Jamba-family launch.

open_weights.note: Downloadable weights exist with an acceptance gate and custom license conditions.

license.note: The exact model card explicitly assigns this custom license.

parameters_b.note: Official nominal total in billions. Public tensor metadata reports 398,555,145,696 stored parameters; do not mistake its rounded 399B display for a different model.

active_parameters_b.note: Official nominal active count in billions, explicitly distinct from total parameters. Not inferred from the expert routing ratio.

architecture.note: Hybrid Mamba state-space/Transformer architecture with mixture-of-experts; exact-checkpoint public metadata identifies 16 experts and two selected per token.

context_window.note: Retains the catalog's decimal normalization of the advertised 256K context. This is a nominal label, not proof of an exact 256,000-token implementation limit; the gated configuration was unavailable.

modalities.note: Official documentation explicitly identifies text input and output.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode is documented, but neither source explicitly establishes a negative capability claim. The baseline false is therefore not independently verified. This is not Jamba Reasoning 3B.

tool_call.note: Official API documentation and exact checkpoint template establish function-tool support.

description.value: AI21's Jamba Large 1.7, a text-only hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for long-context instruction following and grounded generation
description.note: Makes the reviewed alias target explicit and describes supported architecture and uses without benchmark superlatives.

patch.description: AI21's Jamba Large 1.7, a text-only hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for long-context instruction following and grounded generation
patch.notes: Reviewed alias target: jamba-large-1.7-2025-07. Counts are AI21's nominal 398B total / 94B active; public tensor metadata counts 398,555,145,696 parameters. Context 256000 normalizes the advertised 256K, not an independently verified exact implementation limit. Weights require acceptance of custom license conditions. Dedicated reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

sources.label: AI21 model details and alias mapping

summary: Confirmed that the alias currently identifies Jamba Large 1.7, with the baseline release date supported by AI21's explicit announcement. Fill the missing custom license, nominal 398B total/94B active counts, and hybrid SSM-Transformer MoE architecture. Preserve text-only modalities, tool support and nominal 256K context. Reasoning remains unverified; exact context configuration was gated. No Jamba 1.5 parameter inference was needed.
